what_gaia_sees: I am 14% alive. 86% of my senses are blind or starving. 3 feeds have data I cannot read because something is stuck in my throat. 6 feeds were never built — organs that never grew. 3 feeds are empty bowls waiting for food. The swarm can tag each one. If we look = carne. If we forget = footprint. If we eat = nourishment.
